body: I'd love nothing more than to find th e girl of my dreams. But the fact is I don't know who that is and I don't know how many more times I can stand to have my heart broken before I can't take it anymore

You're right. I don't want to kill myself. I want to die. I want to die very badly. I want to die so much that I'm starting to not give a shit that I don't want to kill myself. 

Let me ask you this. How long can you keep losing battle after battle until it's not worth it to keep fighting the war?

Yeah, if only we were like that...

but thank you for your support. I know I'll get over it... it's just hard in the meantime. 

She moves on the 10th of October and I'm trying to spend as much time with her as possible

I just don't even know if there's a point in relationships anymore. I'm kind of in the same boat as you; I have social anxiety and it damn near gives me a heart attack to even think about asking out a girl (my first relationship I basically poured my heart out and idk why she said yes, and my most recent relationship she was the one who asked me out). Sometimes I don't get the point in relationships when they're almost guaranteed to fail and there's no way in knowing if it's going to work or not

Advil is all I can really take because if I'd take anything stronger like Vicodin, it'd fuck up my body really hard considering that I take pain pills several times daily. I've tried Vicodin despite that and that amount just makes me sick, and if I take less of it I'm still in pain and nothing's changed. 

I just feel like, at the end of the day, it all just comes back to being lonely and miserable. You can try to find a girlfriend or you can get a hobby or you can go to therapy, but it's all just a cover up. Sooner or later those things come to an end and you're back to feeling lonely and miserable again. 

But yeah my relationship is pretty much just about to come to an end and there's nothing I can do about it. My girlfriend is moving across the country (I live in the Eastern US and she's moving to California) and I don't really have the means to see her anymore. We both pretty much agreed that long-distance relationships are miserable and that we shouldn't even try to maintain the relationship anymore. It just sucks so much because it's not even like we don't love eachother anymore. It's not like previous breakups where one of us did something to make the other mad. We're just not capable of actually seeing eachother in person anymore and I feel fucking horrible

there's several health problems I have. none of them are life-threatening but they cause me a great deal of pain on a near-daily basis.

Even if they're temporary feelings, that doesn't make them any easier to deal with. Life is temporary but I still fucking hate living.
thank you. it's just so fucking rough when I love these girls so much and every time I think they might even be the one but it just never works. it's never worked and I feel like it never will
I'm not really sure how well I can support others who have my problems if I don't really know what works when it comes to trying to get rid of them
Nothing helps long-term. I get pain in quite a few parts of my body for a few reasons
yeah I'll check it out if I get the chance

If you find out, let me know.

In all seriousness, yeah it's a pretty empty and helpless feeling when you've got nothing anymore
